says:
Every fixed literal this product uses that another product of the family must not reuse, by role. Each entry names the place in the code that defines the literal for this register (its `at`); a test reads this file and checks each entry against that place, both ways. A few literals are also spelled elsewhere: the product's name in the system's folder names and window captions, the trace variable in each crate that writes the trace. Entries whose `says` call them contact paths are literals another program reads when it reads this product's data. Byte literals with a line end are written with it (
).
